# Repository Map Maintenance

## Generated Files

- `docs/repository-map/repository-map.json` is generated by `scripts/repository-map/generate-repository-map.mjs`.
- Structural fields include file list, hashes, byte and line counts, imports, exports, reverse imports, side effects, package scripts, dependency graph, and generated/reference flags.
- The generator preserves existing semantic `documentation` notes and findings when refreshing records.

## Manually Maintained Files

Narrative Markdown files under `docs/repository-map/` and `docs/repository-map/areas/` are manually maintained. `repository-map.schema.json` and the generator/validator scripts are maintained source files.

## Commands

```text
npm run docs:repo-map
npm run docs:repo-map:check
```

On this PowerShell environment use:

```text
npm.cmd run docs:repo-map
npm.cmd run docs:repo-map:check
```

## When To Update

Update the repository map when any of these change:

- files are added, deleted, moved, or renamed.
- imports, exports, or public module contracts change.
- a route or query-driven entry point changes.
- state ownership moves between files.
- browser storage, history, clipboard, downloads, or event listeners are added.
- content schemas, content packs, or adapters change.
- map generation, rendering, editor behavior, or export payloads change.
- QA commands, test ownership, or generated file ownership changes.
- a legacy or reference-only system becomes current, or current code becomes legacy.

## Adding Files Or Areas

Add the file in the appropriate feature, shared, script, docs, or asset directory. Regenerate the map so the new file is represented. If the file starts a new architectural area, add an area doc under `docs/repository-map/areas/` and link it from [index.md](index.md).

## Dynamic Imports And Low Confidence

Static string dynamic imports are captured when possible. Ambiguous dynamic relationships should be documented in the relevant area doc with a confidence marker. Do not present inferred relationships as confirmed facts.

## Stale Hashes

If validation reports stale generated structural data, run `npm run docs:repo-map` and validate again. If hashes remain stale, inspect the generator and self-hash exemption for `repository-map.json`.
